blocks.text: MONTREAL — A “serious incident” at a military base in western Canada killed and injured multiple people and sparked a huge blaze on Saturday, the government said. Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney posted on X that “a serious incident creating a major fire” had occurred at Canadian Forces Base Wainwright military base in western Alberta province. There were “both fatalities and injuries” as a result of the incident, the country’s defense minister, David McGuinty, said at a news conference.
